sourceContext.originPage: Momentum model page (template "model", 23 RV model pages)

visualCharacteristics.purpose: sticky model sub-navigation with floorplan dropdown, section jump links and brochure download
notes: Section sticks below the fixed site header (top: var(--nav-height))
Floorplans dropdown is a disclosure button (aria-expanded, Esc closes)

contentPattern.structure: two columns, three rows. Row 1: model name | Download Brochure link (PDF). Row 2: "Floorplans" | bulleted list, one item per floorplan: thumbnail image, floorplan name linked to its page, then lines "Hitch 3,500", "UVW 15,910", "Length 39' 11"" and optionally "Dealer stock only" (separate lines or one line). Row 3: "Links" | bulleted list of in-page links (Exterior -> #brand-360spin, Construction -> #brand-construction, Specification -> #brand-floorplanspecs, Testimonials -> #brand-testimonials). Floorplans and Links rows are optional

suitableFor: RV model pages (one per page, first section)
notSuitableFor: floorplan detail pages without section anchors
